description: G1 ground MVP support relationship scenario. It validates Army/ground TASK_SUPPORT common-core relationship semantics and preservation of supported_node_id/supporting_node_id through ScenarioLoader and TaskOrder -> LeaderIntent -> PilotReport status propagation. The single entity intentionally uses the current runtime-compatible Aircraft spawn shell; this scenario does not claim fire support, sustainment, or movement behavior.
